name: pi-starline
notes: Local divergence, reconstructed 2026-09-19 from diff vs upstream e54af55 (v0.3.5): (1) mouse features no longer patch TuiAltScreen.prototype — they register with the local @xzzpig/pi-mouse-events extension (optional peer >=0.1.0 <2, devDep workspace:*): wheel/press/copy handler slots, keyboard range-delete via ctx.ui.onTerminalInput; without it mouse features are simply off (no fallback), one console note per process. Click-to-expand toggles from any row of an expandable component (hint row or the component's expanded/_expanded state field), plain same-cell click only, double-click debounced; mouse/capabilities.ts probes the receiver for calling (not patching) plus copySlot; prototype-patch-registry drops the four mouse adapter keys. mouse/api-consumer.ts reads the API off Symbol.for('pi-mouse-events.api.v1') (duplicated key pinned by test/contract/mouse-api.test.ts); test/mouse/shim.ts replays the dispatch for the behavioural suites. (2) every git probe in extensions/starline/git.ts passes --no-optional-locks (index.lock churn; test/git-no-optional-locks.test.ts). (3) npm renamed @xzzpig/pi-starline, fork version 0.4.0 (0.x fork convention: upstream minor bump -> fork minor bump), README install section updated, CHANGELOG rewritten fork-only. (4) test/runtime.test.ts passes an explicit empty env to detectRuntime so ambient Nix markers (IN_NIX_SHELL) do not shadow file-marker fixtures (uses upstream's optional env param; runtime.ts itself unchanged). (5) comment-only additions: ui.ts SAFETY/pi-lens-ignore notes, config.ts empty-catch note. Keep package-lock.json in npm's native tab indentation (restored to upstream bytes + name/version lines on 2026-09-19); biome protects package-lock.json and root prettier ignores this package. Re-apply all of the above on each future sync. 2026-09-19 hardening: mouse/api-consumer.ts rejects an API object whose version !== 1, and test/contract/mouse-api.test.ts pins the slot-dispatch semantics (priority order, consume-on-first-handled, skip-throwing, fall-through) against the real implementation via the new @xzzpig/pi-mouse-events/test-support export (pi-mouse-events 0.1.2), so shim drift goes red in the contract suite.
